name: step-load-transient
title: Step-load transient — generic cantilever, Newmark dynamics
teaches: Density on the material (nDMaterial rho) plus a Constant-series step load excites a real dynamic response; Newmark(0.5, 0.25) + Transient integration; the Ladruno recorder's -G energy channel (KE/IE/DW/ULW/RES/ERR) as the solution-quality diagnostic for explicit/implicit transient runs. A static twin built off the same mesh gives the dynamic amplification factor.
provenance: pattern ported from a private out-of-repo transient case's deck/chain/recorder driver (density + Constant-series step load + Newmark + Ladruno -G energy); geometry is generic (a small solid cantilever box) — the specimen geometry does not ship, per ADR 0095 Amendment 7.

metrics.name: daf
metrics.note: peak |tip Uz| (transient) / tip Uz (static, full load) — measured 2026-08-17; theoretical undamped step-load DAF is 2.0.

metrics.name: last_err_pct
metrics.note: Results.energy()['ERR'] at the last committed step — must stay under 1% (amendment oracle). Measured 0.806%.

metrics.name: energy_ratio
metrics.note: (KE+IE)/ULW at the last committed step — measured 0.9546 (closure within ~4.5%).
